paragraphs:
I’m Anish, an AI-focused Software Engineer building intelligent, scalable software products. I work across
          Generative AI, full-stack development, backend systems
          and cloud technologies, turning real-world problems into practical solutions. My focus includes LLM
          applications, RAG, AI agents, automation, and product engineering,
          with hands-on experience building and deploying end-to-end applications.

A Software Engineer passionate about building AI-powered and cloud-driven products that turn ideas into
              meaningful solutions.
              I enjoy working across AI, full-stack engineering, and cloud technologies, while also building
              communities, collaborating with people,
              and sharing what I learn. As a Google Cloud Program Lead ’25, I’ve developed a strong interest in both
              technology and the people
              behind it—building, experimenting, learning, and creating an impact beyond just code.
